title: Robert Schoch's solar flare and Lichtenberg figure idea
summary: Geoffrey Drumm tells of Robert Schoch's solar flare and Lichtenberg figure idea, about prehistoric at Egypt (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: but he thinks that the Giza plateau was hit by a solar flare

plain: Geoffrey Drumm, who studies the pyramids of Egypt, relays an idea from a geologist named Robert Schoch: that the Giza plateau, the site of the Great Pyramids, was hit by a solar flare in the distant past. The idea is tied to Lichtenberg figures, the branching tree-like marks left by powerful electrical discharges. If true, it would mean some of the marks at Giza were made by a blast of energy from the sun.
